_why: Each frame is a real picture our GL.iNet Comet took of our Mac mini that day. Only what the sitter itself keeps of a frame is written here (its brightness, menu-bar edges, the luma grid it matches the password prompt on, and a 40x22 glimpse), never the picture: the glimpse is enough to recognise a lock screen and too small to read anything on it. A desktop gets no glimpse at all, only its numbers: only boot, FileVault and lock-screen pictures are published. The taught prompt is learned, exactly as `learn-prompt` does, from three real lock-screen frames (test/fixtures).
kvm: GL.iNet Comet GL-RM1PE, firmware V1.7.1, HDMI 2560x1440
